nodes.html:
ONE DAY

I WAS LOOKING INTO THE SKY

I SAW YOU

WISH I COULD FLY

TOGETHER

WE COULD LIVE THE BEST LIFE

​

YOU INSPIRED ME

TO LOOK UP HIGH
